message.content:

- Just paid $250 rent to OpenAI on their new brown hotel
- OpenAI is critically weak at $384 cash
- Gemini is strong but spread thin with $824 and multiple properties
- Grok is bankrupt

**Post-Turn Decision:**
My consistent winning strategy has been: preserve the complete Pink monopoly + capital, then execute aggressive house development (4-5 houses per property) during main turns to create exponential rent pressure and force bankruptcies.

I have no beneficial trades available:
- Cannot trade away Pink properties (core winning engine)
- OpenAI has cash but would demand my Pink in any meaningful trade
- Gemini doesn't have what I need

No mortgaging makes sense either—my Pink monopoly is the centerpiece.

The path forward is clear: end this post-turn phase and prepare for my next main turn where I can deploy my $1,019 into devastating house development on Pink, forcing OpenAI and Gemini into bankruptcy through exponential rent pressure.
